answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to be a financier. I want to provide the necessary capital to talented and creative minds to construct movies that promote the good, true, and beautiful.
answers.drew: I’ve always been drawn to stories, especially stories that promote inherent underlying moral truths and beliefs. As someone who’s in hard tech, I want to transition out of the oil and gas business and use my money to allow the most talented and brilliant creative minds to tell their stories
